name: EGAD!
summary: 面向机器人抓取训练与可复现评测的程序化物体数据集，包含 2000 余个覆盖不同几何复杂度和抓取难度的生成物体，以及 49 个可三维打印的评测物体。
summaryEn: A procedurally generated robotic grasping dataset with over 2,000 objects spanning geometric complexity and grasp difficulty, plus 49 reproducible 3D-printable evaluation objects.
scaleZh: 2000 余个生成物体 · 49 个可打印评测物体
organizationsZh: 爱丁堡大学及合作团队
license: Dataset terms are provided through the official project; verify before reuse
licenseZh: 数据条款见官方项目；复用前需核验
access: Dataset download and generation code available from the official project
accessZh: 官方项目提供数据下载和生成代码
wmNote: 物体形状与抓取难度的系统变化适合研究几何物理表征和抓取评测，但不包含长时交互轨迹。
wmNoteEn: Systematic variation in object shape and grasp difficulty supports geometric-physical representation and grasp evaluation, but the dataset has no long-horizon interaction trajectories.
